note: "Order". Among 8,192 latents it parts into "in order to" and the order that is an arrangement ("the order of the prayers"); among 16,384, "in order to" parts again, by whether it opens the sentence or comes in its middle.

How probable something is. Among 8,192 latents it parts into "likely", the risk of something, and "a chance"; among 16,384 the chance parts into an opportunity ("a chance to watch") and a probability ("Chances are").
"Right" and "straight" as adverbs. Among 8,192 latents the two words part; among 16,384, "right now" parts from "right away", and "directly" from "a straight line".
